card.name: Linking words before glucose monitor terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation just before a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) or insulin pump is named, mostly in the hydroxyurea CGM interference warning.

modes.label: Before CGM named
modes.description: Article, preposition or parenthesis right before the words continuous glucose monitoring or CGM.
modes.example: If a patient using<< a>> CGM is to be prescribed hydroxy

modes.label: Before insulin pump terms
modes.description: Small word before insulin pump or infusion device wording.
modes.example: Malfunction of<< the>> insulin pump or insulin infusion set or insulin
